items.title: Limitations: Operating Limits
items.description: A complete walkthrough of every operating limitation for the AS350 B3 2B1 — weight, flight envelope, rotor, engine, and electrical limits — with a brief note on why each one is set where it is.

items.title: Engine Flame-Out: Autorotation and Recovery
items.description: How to recognize and handle an engine flame-out, followed through a real autorotation from first indication to a safe landing.
